trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: SMC bearish order block mitigation on M15/H1 aligns with a major Supply Zone at 80000-80100 and Quarter Theory (80000 major level), validated by H4 bearish trend indicators (EMA50 dynamic resistance). The interaction of the psychological quarter level and the supply zone creates a strong barrier where sellers are highly likely to defend, causing a preemptive wick rejection.

Confluence 2: Bearish Break of Structure (BOS) below 79800 on M15/M5 aligns with an unmitigated M15 Fair Value Gap (FVG) between 79986.02 and 80003.74 and H1 Candlestick Patterns (shooting star rejection at 80426), validated by Momentum Indicators (RSI at 34.0 confirming strong bearish momentum). The break of structure confirms the shift in order flow, and the FVG acts as a magnet that pulls price back up to be mitigated before continuation.

Confluence 3: MSNR Malaysian SNR resistance at 80000 aligns with Candle Range Theory (CRT) bearish expansion and a Double Top Chart Pattern at 80426/80443.99, validated by Volatility Indicators (ATR of 221.75 supporting a deep wick-rejection entry). The double top pattern establishes a strong ceiling, and the high ATR indicates that any retracement into the CRT premium zone will be swift and sharp, perfect for a preemptive limit order.

Confluence 4: Fibonacci Retracement (0.382 retracement at 80002) aligns with Fibonacci Circles resistance arcs and SMC premium mitigation, validated by Volume Indicators showing bearish volume expansion on the breakdown. The confluence of the 0.382 Fib level and the circle arcs creates a geometric intersection of price and time, where the high volume on the initial breakdown confirms institutional interest in pushing price lower from this premium.

Confluence 5: Standard Deviation (1 SD mean reversion to 80000) aligns with a bearish Trendline Break & Bounce from H4 highs and unmitigated supply at 80050, validated by Trend Indicators (Ichimoku cloud resistance on M15/H1). The mean reversion to 1 SD brings price back to the bearish trendline and the Ichimoku cloud, where the unmitigated supply zone acts as a hard ceiling, triggering a rapid rejection.

Multiple confluences align at the 80015.00 defensive staff zone, including the 0.382 Fibonacci retracement and an unmitigated M15 FVG, while the Buy scenario fails almost all doctrine checks.
